name: Little Richard
hook: A singer and pianist from Macon, Georgia, whose screamed, pounding records the Beatles and the Kinks learned from, and who spent decades suing for the royalties.
blurb: Little Richard was born Richard Penniman in Macon, Georgia, in 1932. In September 1955 he recorded 'Tutti Frutti' at Cosimo Matassa's J&M Studio in New Orleans for Specialty Records, after the songwriter Dorothy LaBostrie cleaned up his rude lyrics. His records were loud and wild: pounding piano, screaming, saxophone. 'Long Tall Sally' (1956) went to number one on the R&B chart. In 1957 he quit rock and roll to study religion. When he came back, Brian Epstein booked the Beatles to open for him in 1962, in New Brighton and at Hamburg's Star-Club, and he coached Paul McCartney in the high, screamed singing McCartney used on the Beatles' rock and roll covers. Both the Beatles and the Kinks recorded 'Long Tall Sally'. In 1984 he sued Specialty and its owner Art Rupe for $112 million in royalties unpaid since 1959, and the case was settled in 1986. He died in 2020.
